fields.label: Exterior Score 1
basic:
ROUND(IF(
    {driver_fro}="Ok", 10, (100 - SUM(
            IF(SEARCH("Repainted",{driver_fro})>0, 20,0),
            IF(SEARCH("Minor Scratches",{driver_fro})>0, 7,0),
            IF(SEARCH("Major Scratches",{driver_fro})>0, 8,0),
            IF(SEARCH("Minor Dents",{driver_fro})>0, 10,0),
            IF(SEARCH("Major Dents",{driver_fro})>0, 15,0),
            IF(SEARCH("Rusted",{driver_fro})>0, 25,0),
            IF(SEARCH("Not Opening Comfortably",{driver_fro})>0, 15,0)
        )) / 10
)*17.82/500,2)
